rounds.name: Crimean Peninsula
rounds.fact: The Crimean Peninsula extends into the Black Sea and is connected to the mainland by the narrow Isthmus of Perekop.

rounds.name: Taiwan Strait
rounds.fact: The Taiwan Strait separates the island of Taiwan from the continental Asian mainland.

rounds.name: Great Australian Bight
rounds.fact: The Great Australian Bight is a vast open bay off the southern coastline of the Australian continent.

rounds.name: Newfoundland
rounds.fact: Newfoundland is a large island off the eastern coast of North America, blocking the mouth of the Saint Lawrence River.

rounds.name: Cape Agulhas
rounds.fact: Cape Agulhas is the true southernmost point of the African continent and the official dividing line between the Atlantic and Indian Oceans.
